shellCommands.command:
PORT=4321 node /workspace/server.js > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > /tmp/server.pid
sleep 1
cat /tmp/server.log
echo "---PID---"
cat /tmp/server.pid

curl -sS -o /tmp/home.html -w "GET / -> %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:4321/
curl -sS -o /tmp/new.html -w "GET /books/new -> %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:4321/books/new
echo "--- HOME preview ---"
grep -E "Currently reading|Finished|Add book|empty" /tmp/home.html | head
echo "--- NEW preview ---"
grep -E "Add a book|Title|Author|Notes" /tmp/new.html | head

echo "--- POST /books (valid) ---"
curl -sS -i -X POST http://127.0.0.1:4321/books \
  -d "title=The Pragmatic Programmer&author=Andrew Hunt&notes=Re-reading after a few years" | head -8
echo ""
echo "--- POST /books (missing title) ---"
curl -sS -o /tmp/error.html -w "status=%{http_code}\n" -X POST http://127.0.0.1:4321/books \
  -d "title=&author=&notes="
grep -E "Title is required" /tmp/error.html
echo ""
echo "--- Check JSON file ---"
cat /workspace/data/books.json

echo "--- Add second book ---"
curl -sS -i -X POST http://127.0.0.1:4321/books \
  -d "title=Project Hail Mary&author=Andy Weir&notes=" | grep -E "^HTTP|^location"
echo ""
echo "--- List books (find ids) ---"
IDS=$(node -e "import('./lib/store.js').then(s => s.listBooks()).then(b => { b.forEach(x => console.log(x.id, x.title, x.status)); })")
echo "$IDS"
ID1=$(echo "$IDS" | head -1 | awk '{print $1}')
ID2=$(echo "$IDS" | tail -1 | awk '{print $1}')
echo "ID1=$ID1  ID2=$ID2"
echo ""
echo "--- GET /books/<id> ---"
curl -sS -o /tmp/detail.html -w "status=%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:4321/books/$ID1
grep -E "The Pragmatic Programmer|Andrew Hunt|reading since|Update notes|Mark as finished" /tmp/detail.html
echo ""
echo "--- POST /books/<id>/finish ---"
curl -sS -i -X POST http://127.0.0.1:4321/books/$ID1/finish | grep -E "^HTTP|^location"
echo ""
echo "--- GET detail page (should now show finished badge) ---"
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:4321/books/$ID1 | grep -E "finished [0-9]|badge done|Move back"
echo ""
echo "--- POST /books/<id>/notes (update) ---"
curl -sS -i -X POST http://127.0.0.1:4321/books/$ID2/notes \
  -d "notes=Rocky is the best character." | grep -E "^HTTP|^location"
echo ""
echo "--- Verify notes saved ---"
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:4321/books/$ID2 | grep -E "Rocky"

echo "--- Home now reflects state ---"
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:4321/ | grep -E "Currently reading|Finished|book-title|book-author" | head -10
echo ""
echo "--- 404 for unknown id ---"
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "/books/nonexistent -> %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:4321/books/nonexistent
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "/books/aaaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa -> %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:4321/books/aaaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "/wat -> %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:4321/wat
echo ""
echo "--- Direct link to a single book works ---"
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:4321/books/64d0d5c2-afe7-42f5-bda3-a743d755dad7 | grep -E "<title>|<h2>The Pragmatic"
echo ""
echo "--- JSON on disk before restart ---"
cat /workspace/data/books.json
echo ""
echo "--- Stop server, restart, verify persistence ---"
kill $(cat /tmp/server.pid) 2>/dev/null
sleep 0.5
PORT=4321 node /workspace/server.js > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > /tmp/server.pid
sleep 1
cat /tmp/server.log
echo "--- Books visible after restart ---"
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:4321/ | grep -E "Currently reading|Finished"

kill $(cat /tmp/server.pid) 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.3
echo "[]" > /workspace/data/books.json
ls -la /workspace
echo "---"
ls /workspace/lib /workspace/data
